impacts.description: Improved employability and career prospects of MSCA postdoctoral fellows within academia and beyond, contributing to a more mobile and highly skilled European research workforce.
impacts.source_section: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows

impacts.description: Increased and broadened research and innovation impact through enhanced networking and communication capacities with scientific peers and the general public.
impacts.source_section: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows

impacts.description: Stronger R&I capacity and output among participating organisations and better transfer of knowledge between participating organisations.
Increased global attractiveness, visibility and reputation of the participating organisation(s) and, by extension, of the European Research Area.

Increased alignment of working conditions for researchers in accordance with the principles set out in the European Charter for Researchers, contributing to more equitable and attractive research careers across Europe.
Regular feedback of research results into teaching and education at participating organisations, sustaining knowledge circulation between research and education.
impacts.inference_note: The call states 'regular feedback of research results into teaching and education at participating organisations' as an expected outcome; the impact framing — sustained knowledge circulation between research and education — is inferred as the systemic effect of that feedback loop, beyond the immediate organisational outcome.

impacts.description: New mind-sets and approaches to R&I work fostered through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience, enriching the broader European research culture.
impacts.source_section: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows
impacts.inference_note: The call states 'new mind-sets and approaches to R&I work forged through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience' as an expected outcome for fellows; the impact on the broader European research culture is inferred as the systemic effect of many fellows bringing these new approaches back into host organisations and the research community.
